verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Modal, but the evidence pack does not document any feature for exporting all account or workspace data in open formats. The OpenTelemetry export of traces and metrics is an observability feature, not a full data export. Containerized deployment is not data export either, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
